subject: How  to create 'pivot table' with categoricals on rows and columns ?

messages.author: 92a46c9449c605e2
messages.subject: How  to create 'pivot table' with categoricals on rows and columns ?
parts:
Hi, might anyone know how to create output where you can specify not
only categorical rows but also categorical columns. An aggregating
function (i.e. sum or mean) must also be specifiable for the 'cells'.

I'm thinking this would work like ftable, but without being limited to
data counts.

I've tried the cast function, but formulas of type <categorical 1> ~
<measure> ~ <categorical 2> produce separate tables, one below the
other, for each value of <categorical 2> ... looking to make them side
by side.

My ultimate goal is to save the output to format that can be imported
into Excel.

Many thanks for any insight ...

Mauricio
